description: A small toy kitchen is in front with a two-burner stovetop, hanging utensils and pans, a sink with a yellow soap bottle, and a bowl on the floor by the cabinet. The left hand reaches down to lift a toy egg from the bowl, slides open the lower cabinet to reveal an egg carton, then places the egg inside and closes it; afterward the left hand moves right to hang a ladle on a hook and then lifts a small pot lid from the right side and brings it up toward the hooks above the stove, while the right hand stays mostly out of the action.
